trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle and significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency irregular serrations. The right lobe exhibits extreme jaggedness with three deep, high-amplitude notches near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a standard convex curve towards the tip. The right lobe follows a broken convex trajectory, ending in an irregular, truncated tip shape.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity white punctate clusters visible against the dark dorsal background, concentrated near the trailing edge of the right lobe and the central notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, light-grey vertical linear streaks are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular marginal tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, creating a distinctive saw-tooth profile.
other_distinctive_markers: The image captures the dorsal (dark) surface of the fluke; ventral pigmentation is entirely occluded by the orientation of the whale.
